top_3_arguments: Severely extended into the breakout — chasing here is buying the top of a parabolic run. daily z_score_50 = 2.07 and hourly z_score_120 = 2.5 (both >2 standard deviations); price is 15.47% above sma_50 and 19.56% above sma_200; bollinger.pct_b = 1.0666 daily (price closed ABOVE the upper band at 183.66) and hourly rsi_21 = 81.07 / daily rsi_7 = 77.88. roc_21d = 14.23%. A breakout entry at 185.75 has almost no cushion before mean reversion to ema_5 (180.15) or fib_236 (181.03).

The breakout candle itself shows distribution/rejection, not clean acceptance. On 2026-05-28 (volume bar) the high tagged 188.50 but the bar CLOSED at 185.46 — a ~$3.04 upper wick (close was only 80% of the daily range), and that 188.50 is now fresh overhead supply: hourly support_resistance.nearest_resistance = 188.50. The watch_level of 185.75 is right under that wick and under hourly fib_236 = 185.08 / fib_382 = 182.96 retrace zone, so any push higher runs straight into yesterday's failed level.

Reward-to-risk is thin against the setup's own levels and the analyst ceiling. From watch_level 185.75 to the prior swing-high resistance at 188.50 is only +1.5% of headroom before sellers reappear, while invalidation at 183.50 is -1.2% — roughly 1.2:1 even before slippage, and atr_14 = 5.65 (3.05% daily range) means a single normal session can whipsaw through both. Compounding this, analyst_consensus_web.avg_price_target = 182.79 sits BELOW the current 185.46 close — the average target is already exceeded, so the easy upside has been front-run.
